node.statement: Fix W_RF, (H,Phi,eta), S, Delta-prime, Delta, Upsilon-prime, and X exactly as quantified in node 1, and assume 0 <= eta <= rho_Upsilon. Then the scalar definition of rho_Upsilon and the imported lemmas give eta <= rho_unit, eta <= rho_Upsilon-prime, Upsilon-prime completely positive, ||Upsilon-prime-tilde-Upsilon||_cb <= C_Upsilon-prime*eta, and ||tilde-Upsilon(I)-I|| <= C_T*eta; moreover d:=(C_T+C_Upsilon-prime)*eta satisfies 0 <= d <= 1/2.
